article.story: North Carolina A&T Aggies (1-1) at East Carolina Pirates (1-1) Greenville, North Carolina; Wednesday, 4 p.m. EST LINE: Pirates -10.5; over/under is 152.5 BOTTOM LINE: N.C. A&T visits East Carolina after Ponce James scored 21 points in N.C. A&T's 80-70 loss to the Ohio Bobcats. East Carolina finished 11-20 overall with a 7-10 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Pirates averaged 71.5 points per game while allowing opponents to score 77.5 last season. N.C. A&T went 4-15 in CAA play and 4-11 on the road last season. The Aggies averaged 75.1 points per game last season, 18.0 on free throws and 17.1 from deep. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
